title: Russian-Style Chinese Pilaf
description: A twist on traditional Chinese pilaf, adding a Russian flavor with lightly buttery notes.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the Fideo and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the Lightly buttery Russian rice and stir to combine.
Add the salt and black pepper to taste.
Add 2 cups of water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and stir in the sesame oil.
